body:
The first Golem's Client build.

- Golem's Client name, logo and Iron colours (Poppy red accent, Inter font)
- Minecraft 1.21.11 with Fabric, with the HUD, Performance, Quality of Life and Utility bundles
- Sign in with Microsoft, Discord Rich Presence
- No telemetry or crash reporting
- Discord, TikTok and GitHub links in Settings
